units.source_text: 此诗并不甚佳，但在此时由女儿低声唱出，夕雾觉得亦甚美妙。

en.t: The poem was not especially fine, but when his daughter sang it softly at that moment, Yugiri found it very beautiful all the same.

units.source_text: 他就叫小少将君向公主传言数语。

en.t: He then asked Koshosho no Kimi to convey a few words to the princess.

units.source_text: 公主命小少将君答道：“此刻我在世间，犹似身在愁梦之中。

en.t: The princess had Koshosho no Kimi reply, "At this moment, though I remain in this world, it is as if I am living inside a sorrowful dream.

units.source_text: 且待此梦稍醒，自当答谢屡次枉驾之恩。”

en.t: Please wait until this dream has cleared a little; then I shall properly thank you for the kindness of your repeated visits."

units.source_text: 只此数语，真乃十分冷淡的应酬。

en.t: These few words alone made for a truly very cold courtesy reply.

units.source_text: 夕雾觉得公主太无情，只得长吁短叹地独自回京。

en.t: Yugiri felt that the princess was far too heartless, and had no choice but to return to the capital alone, sighing deeply again and again.
